P01.descricao: A black glass perfume bottle with a faceted gold cap and a flat cream label reading NOIR

restricoes: Keep the label flat, sharp and readable.

tomadas.ambiente: A dark studio with a polished obsidian plinth
tomadas.acao: A thin curl of mist drifts past the bottle and clears
tomadas.enquadramento: Extreme close-up on the cap, eye level
tomadas.otica: 100mm macro look, shallow depth of field
tomadas.luz: Single hard rim light from camera left, deep black background
tomadas.final: The cap fills the upper third of the frame
tomadas.som: Low airy hum, a soft glass chime as the mist clears

tomadas.ambiente: The same dark studio and obsidian plinth
tomadas.acao: The bottle stays still while light sweeps across the facets
tomadas.camera: Slow 90-degree orbit to the right at constant speed
tomadas.luz: Moving soft rim light, controlled specular highlights

tomadas.ambiente: The same dark studio, now with a faint warm haze
tomadas.acao: A woman's hand enters frame and lifts the bottle off the plinth
tomadas.luz: Warm key from the right, soft fill
tomadas.final: Hero frame: bottle held at center, label readable
tomadas.som: A soft glass tap, then silence
